phase: Author correction of regression reconciliation and CI completeness

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Skipped testcase elements treated as PASS
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: Missing failure or skipped element parsed with status='PASS', causing skipped tests that failed in baseline to be marked RESOLVED
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: load_junit explicitly recognizes <skipped> as status='SKIP', tracks unexpected skips, and strict mode rejects unexpected skips

counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: cases[(c, n)] overwrote earlier execution phases or subtests, silently losing failures if followed by a pass
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: load_junit stores complete record lists per node, computes composite status (ERROR > FAIL > SKIP > PASS), and preserves all record evidence

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Added failing nodes and environment failures pass --strict
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: Only new_regressions_count > 0 triggered failure in --strict, allowing ADDED_FAIL and ENVIRONMENT to exit 0
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Strict acceptance policy evaluates blocking_violations including added_failures_count and environment_failures_count

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Missing nodes counted without expected execution set
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: Removed nodes count was computed against the full 6343 baseline suite, falsely labeling 4496 unexecuted tests deleted
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Expected manifest parsed from pytest --collect-only; baseline partitioned into in-scope and out-of-scope; missing in-scope nodes rejected

counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: An empty XML with 0 testcases resulted in 0 new regressions and exited 0 under --strict
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Strict acceptance explicitly requires current_nodes > 0 and 0 missing expected nodes

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Baseline/current failure pairs called inherited without comparing failure characteristics
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: Any test failing in both was marked inherited regardless of phase change, exception mismatch, or assertion drift
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: compare_failure_details verifies phase, refusal code, exception type, and assertion consistency, rejecting changed non-successes

counterexamples_demonstrated.flaw: Pytest exit code discarded in CI workflow
counterexamples_demonstrated.symptom: Broad regression ran with set +e, ignoring interruption (2), internal error (3), usage error (4), and no-tests (5)
counterexamples_demonstrated.resolution: Workflow captures pytest_exit, validates against exit codes 2-5, and passes exit code to comparator under documented scoped policy
